official_entity: NPO under Law No. 111 of 1999 'On non-profit organizations' (amended by Law No. 72 of 2024); state registration by Ministry of Justice
key_check: Foreigners can register an NPO without a local partner; 2024 foreign-representatives law targets foreign reps, not founding.

official_entity: Non-profit organisation registered under the Non-Profit Organisations Act No. 71 of 1997 with the Department of Social Development
key_check: Registration is voluntary and free; no residency requirement for founders; application filed at the nearest DSD office.

official_entity: Association loi 1901 declared with the prefecture of the siege's department; legal personality from declaration
time_to_register: immediate to a few days; receipt issued on declaration
key_check: Any person incl. foreigners may found; a French seat is needed and declaration can be made by a mandated local person.

official_entity: eingetragener Verein (e. V.) entered in the Amtsgericht Vereinsregister (BGB 55-89); legal capacity after entry
key_check: No residence requirement for board members; German seat needed; notarized application by the Vorstand.

official_entity: Alapitvany (foundation) registered by court under Act V of 2013 (Civil Code) 3:378; CSO Act CLXXV of 2011 applies
time_to_register: no fixed deadline; typically several months
key_check: Foreign founders allowed; Hungarian seat (real estate) and a Hungarian-resident curator are required - a local agent.
